1.w: If, then, you⁺ were raised with Christ, seek the things above, where Christ is sitting at the right hand of God.

2.w: Mind the things above, not the things on the earth.

3.w: For you⁺ died, and your⁺ life has been hidden with Christ in God.

4.w: When Christ, your⁺ life, shall appear, then you⁺ also will appear with Him in glory.

5.w: Put to death, therefore, the members that [are] upon the earth: sexual immorality, impurity, passion, evil desire, and covetousness, which is idolatry,

6.w: because of which things the wrath of God comes on the sons of disobedience,

7.w: in which you⁺ also walked once when you⁺ were living in them.

8.w: But now you⁺ also put off all [these] things: wrath, rage, malice, slander, shameful talk out of your⁺ mouth.

9.w: Do not lie to one another, having put off the old man with his practices,

10.w: and having put on the new, the one being renewed in knowledge according to the image of the One having created him,

11.w: where there is not Greek and Jew, circumcision and uncircumcision, barbarian, Scythian, slave, free; but Christ [is] all and in all.

12.w: Put on, therefore, as the chosen ones of God, holy and beloved, inner parts of compassion, kindness, humility, gentleness, patience,

13.w: bearing with one another and forgiving each other, if anyone may have a complaint toward another. Just as also the Lord forgave you⁺, so also you⁺.

14.w: And over all these, [put on] love, which is the bond of perfection.

15.w: And let the peace of Christ rule in your⁺ hearts, to which also you⁺ were called in one body. And be thankful.

16.w: Let the word of Christ dwell in you⁺ richly in all wisdom, teaching and admonishing each other in psalms, hymns, [and] spiritual songs, in grace singing in your⁺ hearts to God.

17.w: And everything, whatever you⁺ may do in word or in work, do all things in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God the Father through Him.

18.w: Wives, submit yourselves to [your] husbands, as is fitting in the Lord.

19.w: Husbands, love [your] wives and do not be bitter toward them.

20.w: Children, obey [your] parents in all things, for this is well-pleasing in the Lord.

21.w: Fathers, do not provoke your⁺ children, so that they may not become discouraged.

22.w: Slaves, obey according to all things the masters according to flesh, not with eye-services as men-pleasers, but in sincerity of heart, fearing the Lord.

23.w: That which you⁺ may do, work from the soul, as to the Lord and not to men,

24.w: knowing that you⁺ will receive back from the Lord the reward of the inheritance. You⁺ serve the Lord Christ.

25.w: For the one doing wrong will receive what he has done wrong, and there is no partiality.
